description: Give footage items or compositions a proxy (File > Set Proxy): a file or image sequence, a solid or a placeholder, or remove it (None). useProxy switches between the proxy and the original (the proxy indicator in the Project panel)

duration.description: placeholder: seconds. Default the item's duration, or 10

file.description: file, sequence: absolute path (one item only)

forceAlphabetical.description: sequence: Force alphabetical order. Default false

frameRate.description: placeholder: frames per second. Default the item's rate, or 30

height.description: solid, placeholder: pixels. Default the item's height

name.description: solid, placeholder: name. Default the item's name

pixelAspect.description: solid: pixel aspect ratio. Default the item's

proxy.description: What becomes the proxy; none removes it. Omit to only switch useProxy

useProxy.description: Use the proxy (true) or the original (false) everywhere in the project

width.description: solid, placeholder: pixels. Default the item's width

name: set_proxy
title: Set Proxy
